profiles.name: Crusader Kings III
profiles.route: Native mod folder with descriptor.mod; additive data and asset overrides.
constraints: Main character portraits are a 3D pipeline; a PNG portrait is not a drop-in replacement.
Confirm paths, texture compression, material slots, rigs and game version before exporting engine assets.
The scaffold does not replace entire vanilla directories.

profiles.name: Victoria II
profiles.route: Legacy .mod descriptor with a mod directory; data, flags, interface and events.
constraints: Localization is legacy semicolon CSV, not CK3 YAML.
Determine encoding from the installed language/version or localization patch; never assume UTF-8.
Keep existing column layout, IDs and required flag variants; verify image sizes and formats against the target build.

profiles.name: 三国志 / Romance of the Three Kingdoms
profiles.route: Identify the exact title, edition and patch; prefer its supported portrait import/editor, otherwise a version-specific resource adapter.
constraints: This profile covers a series, not a verified archive format.
Base and expansion/PK editions can differ in IDs, sizes, compression and import support.
No generic archive repacker or automatic installation is claimed.

profiles.name: 信长之野望 / Nobunaga's Ambition
profiles.route: Identify the exact title, edition and patch; select a supported portrait importer or build a resource adapter from verified samples.
constraints: Souzou, Taishi and Shinsei must not share an assumed resource format.
Record title, expansion/PK edition, patch and language before authoring import rules.
No generic archive repacker or automatic installation is claimed.
